business_problem: Fraudsters steal payment card numbers through spyware, malware, card skimming, and other clandestine methods, then post partial card numbers on illegal websites, making it difficult to identify compromised cards quickly enough to block fraud.
solution_summary: Mastercard implemented a generative AI-based predictive fraud detection capability within its card security operations to identify compromised payment cards and suspicious merchant exposure faster across its network. The system scans transaction data spanning billions of cards and millions of merchants to detect complex fraud patterns and predict the full details of cards that criminals partially expose on illegal websites. Mastercard says this enhancement strengthens its existing Cyber Secure security suite, which has been available since 2020 and maintains transparent cybersecurity information on bank and merchant online profiles, including suspected compromised cards. In practice, the AI-driven detection layer analyzes large-scale network activity, flags likely compromises, and feeds higher-speed, higher-accuracy alerts to banks so they can block and reissue cards and monitor attempted transactions to mitigate fraud.

solution_components.name: Cyber Secure
solution_components.role: Provides Mastercard's security suite and baseline cybersecurity profiles for banks and merchants, including suspected compromised card information, which the generative AI enhancement strengthens.

data_flow: Transaction data across billions of cards and millions of merchants is scanned to surface complex fraud patterns and predict full compromised card details from partial exposures; the resulting risk signals enhance Cyber Secure and trigger faster, more accurate alerts to banks, which can then block, reissue, and monitor affected cards.
integration_points: Transaction data across Mastercard's card network
business_outcome: Mastercard says the generative AI enhancement lets it detect compromised cards faster and more accurately, helps identify at-risk merchants sooner, and enables banks to block and reissue cards more quickly to reduce fraud.
